title: Follow up on the warranty reply
ask: Yesterday you replied to Ms Okafor about her cracked blender jug; your reply is in sent-reply.md. Today write follow-up.md with the next steps. Quote the clause from policy.md that covers what you told her.
background: She dropped the jug on a tiled floor.
Your reply went to her yesterday at four.
policy.md is our current warranty wording.

start.sent-reply.md:
Dear Ms Okafor,

I am sorry to hear about the jug. Your warranty covers accidental damage, so we will replace it at no cost. I will be in touch with the next steps.
start.policy.md:
Warranty, current wording

1. Faults in materials or workmanship are covered for 24 months.
2. Accidental damage, such as drops, is covered for 24 months.
3. Proof of purchase is required.
